summary: Iteration 66 — CRM Refactor Phase 1 (Relationship OS) regression. BACKEND 7/7 GREEN: GET /summary returns all required keys (account, mood{tags,dominant}, owner, advisor, style, submarket, last_interaction, next_action, insights[]); GET /mood-signals returns {mood:{tags,dominant,secondary,computed_at}}; POST /cultural-editions with target_submarket_code='usa_miami' returns 201 + intent_id + submarket and creates an interaction titled 'Create a Cultural Edition™ · Miami' (verified in timeline); POST /voice-notes (2KB WAV silence) returns 201 with interaction.interaction_type='voice_note' and attachments[0].url is a Supabase signed URL (transcript_ok can be either, both pass); POST /stage with {lifecycle_stage:'lead'} updates account.lifecycle_stage='lead' and lands a stage_change interaction; migration 051 confirmed via /lookups — lifecycle_stage has {lead, prospect, qualified, active_project, client, returning_client, archived} as canonical tenant entries (value_key) and account_type has {hotel_group, yacht_client, luxury_retail, partner_brand}. FRONTEND: /workspace/leads → /crm/accounts ✅, /workspace/clients → /crm/accounts ✅; CRM_TABS only Accounts/Follow-ups/Archived ✅; filter bar with crm-filters + crm-filter-stage/type/health ✅; AccountDetailPage at /crm/accounts/<id> renders with account-detail-page testid ✅; 7 canonical stage pills present and current pill has .rl-stage-pill--current ✅; clicking a non-current stage pill opens StageChangeModal with note textarea + 'Conferma · Prospect' button ✅; quick-add-btn opens menu with EXACTLY 9 items (Log meeting, Call, Voice note, Visit report, Email, Note, Moodboard share, Proposal sent, WhatsApp) ✅; clicking 'Voice note' opens recorder (voice-recorder + voice-record-start testids both present) ✅; right summary panel shows Stage/Owner/Territory cliente/Ultimo contatto/Prossimo follow-up/Mercato culturale/Mood prevalente/Materiali preferiti/Budget range/Timeline progetto + 'Create a Cultural Edition™' button ✅; mobile 390x844 → rl-fab visible + quick-add-btn hidden ✅.

ui_bugs.issue: Relationship Summary Panel renders all required fields visually (STAGE, OWNER, TERRITORY CLIENTE, ULTIMO CONTATTO, PROSSIMO FOLLOW-UP, MERCATO CULTURALE, MOOD PREVALENTE, MATERIALI PREFERITI, BUDGET RANGE, TIMELINE PROGETTO + Create a Cultural Edition™ CTA) but the wrapper element is MISSING data-testid="relationship-summary-panel". Tests cannot anchor to this region by testid as specified in the playbook.

Clicking [data-testid='open-cultural-edition'] does NOT open a modal with data-testid='cultural-edition-modal'. The element does not render after click — no submarket dropdown, no [data-testid='ce-create'] button discoverable. Backend POST works (verified end-to-end from test, interactions are created), but the FRONTEND modal entry point from the Relationship Summary Panel CTA is broken. Phase-1 cultural-edition E2E user flow is therefore unusable from the UI.

The /crm/accounts list page stays at 'Caricamento…' indefinitely on desktop after login — 0 account cards render even though the underlying /api/relationships/accounts API responds and the detail page at /crm/accounts/<id> loads cleanly. No /api 4xx/5xx captured by the response listener but data never populates. This blocks card→detail navigation from the list (workaround: deep link to the account id).

integration_issues.issue: Backend POST /cultural-editions verified (201 + interaction logged), but UI flow blocked because the modal does not open. End user cannot create a Cultural Edition from the new full-page experience.

issues: Editorial luxury layout reads cleanly. Timeline left + summary right split is balanced. Italian copy throughout (Da lead → Prospect modal, Conferma · Prospect, etc.). Stage pill highlight (--current) on Lead is clearly distinguishable. No contrast issues observed on the dark canvas.

action_items: [HIGH] Wire the CulturalEditionModal so that clicking [data-testid='open-cultural-edition'] from the Relationship Summary Panel mounts the modal with [data-testid='cultural-edition-modal'], populates the submarket <select> with 48 options, and exposes [data-testid='ce-create'] for the submit. Backend is ready and verified.

[HIGH] Fix /crm/accounts list page — accounts never load (stays on 'Caricamento…'). Investigate the accounts list fetch in CrmAccountsPage (likely a Supabase query returning empty or a JS guard hanging the spinner). Detail page works fine via deep-link so the underlying data is fine.
[MEDIUM] Add data-testid='relationship-summary-panel' to the right column wrapper in AccountDetailPage. All inner content is correct — just the anchor selector is missing per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_voice_notes.py creates a signed URL with 5-year TTL (157,680,000 s). This works, but Supabase has historically capped signed URL TTLs at ~1 year in some configurations — verify on the actual deployment. If the cap is hit silently the function still returns audio_url=None and the test would have failed, so it's empirically fine today.

crm_intelligence.py best-effort updates accounts with mood_dominant/signal_snapshot on every summary GET — this is a write on a read endpoint. Acceptable as a cache but consider rate-limiting / conditional update (only when mood changes or staleness > N minutes) to avoid write amplification on hot accounts.

Migration 051 keeps legacy editorial stages (discovery/inspiration/editorial_engagement/etc) AND the new canonical stages in the SAME group_key. Front-end stage pill UI correctly filters by metadata.canonical_pipeline (only 7 pills shown). But anywhere else that consumes lifecycle_stage lookups without that filter will show 14+ options — keep an eye on legacy components.

open-cultural-edition button on the panel is wired but the modal mount is broken — likely a missing state hook or a conditional render bug in AccountDetailPage.jsx. Self-test: click the button, watch for state change in React devtools; the modal element should be rendered inside [data-testid='account-detail-page'].

success_rate.frontend: ~80% — 18/21 UI assertions pass. Three blockers: cultural-edition modal not mounting, accounts list stuck loading, summary-panel testid missing.

rca_of_the_issue: Cultural Edition modal: button [data-testid='open-cultural-edition'] is in the DOM and click events fire, but the modal element with [data-testid='cultural-edition-modal'] never appears. Likely culprit: in AccountDetailPage.jsx, the open-state setter for the CulturalEditionModal is either (a) not wired to the button onClick, (b) the modal is rendered conditionally on a flag that never flips, or (c) the testid was added to the trigger but not to the modal root in CulturalEditionModal.jsx. Quick check: open AccountDetailPage.jsx, search for 'cultural-edition-modal' — if not found, add data-testid to the modal root in CulturalEditionModal.jsx AND verify the parent passes open=true on click. Same advisory for relationship-summary-panel testid (the panel renders, just lacks the anchor).
